ja288:1.1: Fish valued in excess of a thousand,
ja288:1.3: To me they were just seven farthings here,
ja288:2.1: Having given food to the fish,
ja288:2.2: to me you gave an offering,
ja288:2.4: that respect was paid by you.
ja288:3.1: There is no growth for one corrupt at heart,
ja288:3.2: Also Devatās do not respect him,
ja288:3.3: He who cheats his brother of paternal
ja288:3.4: Property is one who performs wrong deeds.
